referenceNotes.fr: EL01 : visage âgé et costume ; GA01 : gouache uniquement.
referenceNotes.en: EL01: older face and wardrobe; GA01: gouache only.

prompt: Create a professional CHARACTER CONTINUITY SHEET in HAND-PAINTED WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Preserve the EXACT fictional identity from the named photographic reference: same face shape, eye spacing, nose, brows, mouth, natural skin tone, hair and age. The LAST reference is PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad opaque brush planes, translucent washes, tactile dry edges and reserved paper. Do not borrow faces, costume, pose or scenery from the style reference. Confident visible painted shapes, gently simplified volumes and expressive detailed face. NOT a filtered photograph, NOT 3D, NOT glossy anime. No lettering, names, captions, dates, diagram arrows, watermarks or graphic logos. No tattoos, extra limbs or invented facial marks. Plain warm ivory paper background throughout. Landscape 16:9. REFERENCE1 is Elena age71, SAME woman in all panels. Preserve warm brown skin, face proportions, mature lines and greying natural shoulder-length curls. Healthy ordinary older woman, dignified unposed warmth, not frail and not glamorously de-aged. Plum cardigan over ivory blouse, charcoal straight trousers, burgundy low closed shoes, discreet plain wedding band. No Converse or props. SHEET LAYOUT: exactly THREE clearly separated equal vertical panels: LEFT full-body FRONT standing view, CENTER full-body BACK standing view, RIGHT enlarged THREE-QUARTER head-and-shoulders portrait. Both standing figures are fully framed from top of head through complete shoes, comfortable margin at top and bottom. Same outfit and proportions across every panel. Relaxed neutral posture, empty hands, restrained expression. No additional people or scenery.

qa.fr: Elena âgée et cardigan prune cohérents ; boucles grises conservées. L’âge reste élégant et modéré, à comparer à EL01 avant sélection. Aplats de gouache plus francs et contours sculptés.
qa.en: Older Elena and plum cardigan stay consistent; grey curls preserved. Ageing remains graceful and moderate; compare with EL01 before selection. Bolder gouache planes and sculpted contours.

visualReview.method: Local three-model contact-sheet comparison; final newborn Seedream image also viewed full size.
